title: Select: Using OS native style for the options dropdown (daisyUI)
notes:
Select is used to pick a value from a list of options.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/select/+page.md
code:
<select class="select appearance-none">
  <option disabled selected>Pick a color</option>
  <option>Crimson</option>
  <option>Amber</option>
  <option>Velvet</option>
</select>
